case: ARPA-E GOC Challenge 1 Network Model 01, Scenario 02

opf.formulation: AC polar OPF, upstream PMSC test/PowerModels standard OPF; taps and shunts fixed

scopf.formulation: AC contingency-cut SCOPF, iterative fixed point; fixed taps/shunts, source INL generator response

branch_rating_note: branch_solution.csv gives A/B/C normal/emergency ratings for every circuit; rate A is used for OPF and rate C for SCOPF contingencies.
limitations: SCOPF `run_c1_scopf_contigency_cuts` returns only the base-network solution in its standard API; scopf_ac_all_states.json is an exact final-master solve with the 4 contingencies retained at the converged fixed point.

The upstream SCOPF model uses unbounded contingency generator variables (`bounded=false`); contingency P/Q limit margins are reported and may be negative. These values reveal model behavior and should not be described as all generator limits being enforced.
PowerModels SCOPF convergence criterion is no new violated contingencies found; its output logs warned that some active contingencies remained insecure during intermediate checks.
